ingredient.name: Jarrow Formulas B-Right B族维生素复合胶囊
ingredient.notes: 演练用补剂草稿。英文品名为 Jarrow Formulas B-Right Optimized B-Complex。标签来自用户提供的 iHerb 商品截图和瓶身 Supplement Facts 图片；正式入库前建议复核产品批次和当前销售页面标签是否一致。

labelSources.labelText: Supplement Facts. Serving Size 1 Capsule. Thiamin (as Thiamine Mononitrate) 25 mg; Riboflavin 25 mg; Niacin (as Niacinamide) 25 mg NE; Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine HCl 25 mg and Pyridoxal 5-Phosphate 10 mg) 35 mg; Folate 680 mcg DFE / 400 mcg as (6S)-5-Methyltetrahydrofolate; Vitamin B12 (as Methylcobalamin) 100 mcg; Biotin (as d-Biotin) 300 mcg; Pantothenic Acid (as Calcium D-Pantothenate) 100 mg; Choline (as Choline Bitartrate) 50 mg; Pantethine 25 mg; Inositol 50 mg. Other Ingredients: Capsule (hydroxypropylmethylcellulose), microcrystalline cellulose, silicon dioxide, calcium phosphate, magnesium stearate (vegetable source) and stearic acid (vegetable source).

supplementLabel.notes: B6 label line states 25 mg pyridoxine HCl plus 10 mg pyridoxal 5-phosphate, total 35 mg. Folate line states 680 mcg DFE with 400 mcg as 6S-5-MTHF. Values transcribed from provided image; no concentration was inferred beyond visible label text.
